defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Soft UI Evolution, Bento Box Grid
defaults.c: One brand colour on a quiet neutral ground, with separate status colours that always carry a text label
defaults.t: Named customers with permission, security and privacy summary, uptime history, clear pricing, support response time
defaults.b: Demo request for teams; self-serve sign-up for individuals

rows: SaaS (General)
saas, software, subscription, cloud, b2b, platform, app, teams
Show the real product on the first screen and name the job it does. Link pricing from the header, and keep sign-up to an email and one more field.
Micro SaaS
micro saas, indie, solo founder, niche tool, small team, bootstrapped, side project
One screen, one job: show the tool working in a short loop and a price. Solo products earn trust by showing the maker, the roadmap and a reply address.
AI/Chatbot Platform
ai, chatbot, assistant, llm, agent, prompts, conversation, model
Show a real conversation and what the model can and cannot do. State where data goes, how answers are checked, and how to reach a human.

rows.x: Dark Mode (OLED), Soft UI Evolution, Voice-First Multimodal

rows: API Developer Portal
api, developer portal, keys, sdk, reference, sandbox, webhooks, rate limits
Put a working request and a way to get a key above the fold. Show versions, rate limits, error codes and a status link.
Design System/Component Library
design system, components, tokens, library, ui kit, storybook, patterns, figma
Show components live with their states, tokens and accessibility notes. Version everything and publish a changelog.

rows.d: none needed: the docs are the product

rows: Developer Tool / IDE
developer tool, ide, editor, cli, debugger, code, terminal, extension
Show the tool doing real work in a recorded session, with install in one line. Keep keyboard shortcuts and performance numbers honest and dated.

rows.x: Terminal CLI (Mobile), Flat Design, HUD / Sci-Fi FUI

rows: CRM & Client Management
crm, clients, contacts, pipeline, deals, sales, follow up, notes
Show the pipeline view with real-looking data, import from a spreadsheet, and a calm daily list of who to contact.
Cybersecurity Platform
cybersecurity, threats, soc, alerts, vulnerabilities, compliance, endpoint, incident
Buyers want proof: certifications, third-party audits and how a breach would be handled. Keep alerts readable and never use fear imagery.

rows.x: HUD / Sci-Fi FUI, Flat Design, Real-Time Monitoring

rows: Feature Flag / Config Management
feature flags, config, rollout, toggles, environments, experiments, targeting
Show a flag being changed with its audit trail and rollback. Explain targeting rules in plain examples.
No-code / Low-code Builder
builder, no code, low code, workflows, drag and drop, templates, apps, automation
Let visitors build something in the page. Be clear about limits, export options and what happens to data if they leave.
RPA / Automation Dashboard
rpa, automation, bots, workflows, runs, failures, schedule, orchestration
The dashboard must show failures and who owns them before successes. Offer run history with plain-language error causes.
Survey / Form Builder
survey, form builder, questionnaire, responses, logic, embed, polls, results
Show building a form in seconds and the results view. Say where responses are stored, and keep the published form accessible.
E-signature / Document Workflow
e-signature, signing, contracts, documents, audit trail, templates, legal, workflow
Explain legal validity by region, show the audit trail, and let a visitor sign a sample. Keep the signer's flow free of an account.

rows.t: Signature validity by region, audit trail, encryption summary, retention rules

rows: Productivity Tool
productivity, tasks, to do, projects, planner, focus, work, organise
Show one real day in the tool. Offer import from other apps and a free plan with real limits.

rows.s: Minimalism & Swiss Style + Soft UI Evolution

rows: Remote Work/Collaboration Tool
remote work, collaboration, team, video, docs, async, whiteboard, workspace
Show how a team uses it across time zones. Cover permissions, guest access and admin controls early.
Invoice & Billing Tool
invoice, billing, payments, vat, clients, reminders, quotes, accounting
Show an invoice being made and paid in a short flow. State supported currencies and tax handling, and how data can be exported.
Inventory & Stock Management
inventory, stock, warehouse, sku, reorder, barcode, suppliers, levels
Show low-stock alerts, barcode scanning and a reorder suggestion. Import from a spreadsheet must work on day one.
Email Client
email client, inbox, mail, calendar, sync, folders, search, privacy
Show speed and search on a large inbox. State what data is read, what is tracked, and how to export.

rows.d: none needed: the inbox is the interface

rows: Password Manager
password manager, vault, passkeys, autofill, security, sharing, encryption
Explain the security model in plain terms: what you can and cannot see. Publish audit results and recovery steps.

rows.d: none needed: the vault is the interface

rows: VPN & Privacy Tool
vpn, privacy, tracker blocker, encryption, no logs, servers, speed, anonymous
Back the no-logs claim with an independent audit and its date. Show server locations and speed numbers with method.

rows.d: none needed: connect and status only

rows: File Manager & Transfer
file manager, transfer, upload, share, links, storage, sync, folders
Show a transfer finishing with progress and link expiry. State size limits, retention and encryption in numbers.
Open Source Project Landing
open source, repository, contribute, license, install, library, community, release
Install command, a working example and the licence go first. Show release activity, maintainers and how to contribute.

rows.t: Licence, maintainers, release dates, issue response time

rows: Changelog / Release Notes
changelog, release notes, versions, updates, breaking changes, roadmap, subscribe
Order by date, label breaking changes, link to the migration steps. Let readers subscribe by feed.
Status Page / Incident Management
status, incidents, uptime, outage, maintenance, subscribers, postmortem, components
Say plainly what is broken, since when and when the next update comes. Keep history honest and the page up when the app is down.
Knowledge Base/Documentation
knowledge base, documentation, articles, search, guides, help, faq, support
Search comes first. Write each article for one task, date it, and show a link to contact when it fails.
Testimonial & Social Proof Widget
testimonials, social proof, reviews widget, embed, wall of love, ratings, logos
Embeds must load fast, be readable and never fake. Show sources, dates and a way to remove a review.
Link-in-Bio Page Builder
link in bio, bio link, creators, links page, templates, analytics, social
Offer templates that are not all the same and show the editor in action. Page weight matters for visitors on mobile data.
Notes & Writing App
notes, writing, markdown, editor, sync, folders, focus, drafts
Show the writing surface with nothing else. Local-first or export to plain files builds trust.
Calendar & Scheduling App
calendar, scheduling, meetings, availability, time zones, reminders, booking link
Show how a shared link finds a time that suits both sides. Time zones must be written in words.
Booking & Appointment App
booking app, appointment, reservations, clients, reminders, no shows, payments, schedule
Show both sides: the customer picking a time and the owner seeing the diary. Reminders and deposits should cut no-shows, and the page must say by how much only if measured.
Analytics Dashboard
analytics, dashboard, metrics, reports, funnels, events, charts, insights
Answer one question per chart and say what the date range is. Offer exports, annotations and saved views.

rows.x: Real-Time Monitoring, Executive Dashboard, Comparative Analysis Dashboard

rows: Smart Home/IoT Dashboard
smart home, iot, devices, sensors, automation, energy, rooms, scenes
Rooms and scenes should be the main controls, with device state shown by text and icon. Say what works offline.
EV/Charging Ecosystem
ev, charging, charger map, kwh, network, tariff, session, plug
Show nearby chargers with live availability, price per kWh and plug type. Payment must work without an account.
Autonomous Drone Fleet Manager
drone, fleet, autonomous, missions, telemetry, geofence, battery, operations
Show live positions, battery and mission state with clear alerts. Safety limits and manual override must be obvious.

rows.x: Real-Time Monitoring, Data-Dense Dashboard, Cyberpunk UI

rows: Quantum Computing Interface
quantum, qubits, circuits, simulator, jobs, backend, noise, research
Show circuits, job queues and results with plain explanation of what they mean. Do not promise speed-ups without a source.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, Data-Dense Dashboard, Cyberpunk UI

rows: Space Tech / Aerospace
space, aerospace, satellites, launch, mission, telemetry, orbit, hardware
Missions and numbers tell the story: dated launches, specifications, flight history. Avoid sci-fi clichés and stock stars.

rows.x: Parallax Storytelling, HUD / Sci-Fi FUI, Minimalism & Swiss Style

rows: Spatial Computing OS / App
spatial computing, visionos, headset, 3d windows, hand tracking, mixed reality, ar
Design for depth, gaze and comfort: large targets, short sessions, no head-locked text. Show a capture from the device.
Biotech / Life Sciences
biotech, life sciences, research, pipeline, trials, lab, publications, compound
Explain the science for two readers: investors and specialists. Show the pipeline stage, publications and regulatory status with dates.

rows.x: Editorial Grid / Magazine, Flat Design, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Sustainable Energy / Climate Tech
climate tech, solar, renewable, carbon, energy, grid, emissions, sustainability
Back every claim with a method and a source. Show measured outputs, not artwork of leaves and globes.

rows.x: Nature Distilled, Minimalism & Swiss Style, Editorial Grid / Magazine

rows: GIS / Web Map Dashboard
gis, map, geospatial, layers, features, filters, spatial data, boundaries
The map is the interface: layers panel, legend, search and a table view of the same data. Colour scales must be readable by colour-blind users.
Earth Observation / Satellite Imagery Viewer
satellite imagery, remote sensing, earth observation, layers, time slider, ndvi, tiles
Give a date slider, a layer list and a plain explanation of each band. Say resolution, revisit time and licensing.
Digital Signage / Kiosk
digital signage, kiosk, screens, playlists, remote, display, menus boards, schedule
Show the playlist editor and the screen preview together. Large type, high contrast and an offline fallback matter on the wall.
Patent / IP Database
patent, ip, trademarks, prior art, search, classification, filings, legal
Search must be exact: classifications, dates and boolean operators. Show source coverage and update dates.
